reason: The hypothesis combines separate findings on Al (P8, P18) and Mn (P1, P7, P24) oxidation behavior with a proposed diffusion-based mechanism (P38) to predict a direct, controlled comparison between Al, Mn, and Si additions in a single-phase CrFeCoNi alloy, which no single passage does. It also extends the idea to Si, which is underexplored, and proposes a specific falsification test that would resolve the gap between the protective Al2O3 formation and non-protective Mn-oxide formation under identical conditions.
